# Design point P006

## Description

The system provides each repository with at least three server-side copies, supporting redundancy and capacity after one machine fails. Clients separately perform pack rewriting and deletion of obsolete packs as distinct maintenance operations; these choices address complementary server and client concerns without evident tension.
